verses.text: These were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: His firstborn was Amnon, whose mother was Ahinoam from Jezreel. The second was Daniel, whose mother was Abigail from Carmel.
The third was Absalom, whose mother was Maacah, the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur. The fourth was Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith.
The fifth was Shephatiah, whose mother was Abital. The sixth was Ithream, whose mother was David's wife Eglah.
These six were born to David in Hebron, where he ruled for seven years and six months. Then he ruled in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.
These sons were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. Their mother was Bathshua, the daughter of Ammiel. These were four.
There were also Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet. These were nine.
All these were David's sons, not counting the sons of his concubines. Their sister was Tamar.
Solomon's son was Rehoboam. Rehoboam's son was Abijah. Abijah's son was Asa. Asa's son was Jehoshaphat.
Jehoshaphat's son was Joram. Joram's son was Ahaziah. Ahaziah's son was Joash.
Joash's son was Amaziah. Amaziah's son was Azariah. Azariah's son was Jotham.
Jotham's son was Ahaz. Ahaz's son was Hezekiah. Hezekiah's son was Manasseh.
Manasseh's son was Amon. Amon's son was Josiah.
Josiah's sons were Johanan, the firstborn; Jehoiakim, the second; Zedekiah, the third; and Shallum, the fourth.
Jehoiakim's descendants were his son Jeconiah and his son Zedekiah.
The sons of Jeconiah, who was taken prisoner, were his son Shealtiel,
Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
Pedaiah's sons were Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel's sons were Meshullam and Hananiah. Their sister was Shelomith.
Zerubbabel had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-Hesed.
Hananiah's descendants were Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, and the sons of Shecaniah.
Shecaniah's son was Shemaiah. Shemaiah's six descendants were Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
Neariah's three sons were Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
Elioenai's seven sons were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
